Definition: from G3999 and G5507; five times a thousand:--five thousand.
BiblicalUsage: Pentakischilioi means five thousand. About five thousand men sat down on the grass, and Jesus fed them all from five loaves and two fishes.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that five thousand fed from a boy's lunch is the measure of Christ: He takes what is little and makes it enough for all.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand
